verses.arabicText: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا
verses.transliteration: Wal-dhāriyāti dharwā
verses.translation: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing

verses.arabicText: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا
verses.transliteration: Fal-ḥāmilāti wiq'rā
verses.translation: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]

verses.arabicText: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا
verses.transliteration: Fal-jāriyāti yus'rā
verses.translation: And those [ships] sailing with ease

verses.arabicText: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا
verses.transliteration: Fal-muqasimāti amrā
verses.translation: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter,

verses.arabicText: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
verses.transliteration: Innamā tūʿadūna laṣādiq
verses.translation: Indeed, what you are promised is true.

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
verses.transliteration: Wa-inna d-dīna lawāqiʿ
verses.translation: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.

verses.arabicText: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
verses.transliteration: Wal-samāi dhāti l-ḥubuk
verses.translation: By the heaven containing pathways,

verses.arabicText: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
verses.transliteration: Innakum lafī qawlim-mukh'talif
verses.translation: Indeed, you are in differing speech.

verses.arabicText: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
verses.transliteration: Yu'faku ʿanhu man ufik
verses.translation: Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded.

verses.arabicText: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qutila l-kharāṣūn
verses.translation: Destroyed are the falsifiers

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
verses.transliteration: Alladhīna hum fī ghamratin sāhūn
verses.translation: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.

verses.arabicText: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.transliteration: Yasalūna ayyāna yawmu d-dīn
verses.translation: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yawma hum ʿalā n-nāri yuf'tanūn
verses.translation: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire

verses.arabicText: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Dhūqū fit'natakum hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi tastaʿjilūn
verses.translation: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.transliteration: Inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātiw-waʿuyūn
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,

verses.arabicText: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Ākhidhīna mā ātāhum rabbuhum innahum kānū qabla dhālika muḥ'sinīn
verses.translation: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.

verses.arabicText: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Kānū qalīlam-mina al-layli mā yahjaʿūn
verses.translation: They used to sleep but little of the night,

verses.arabicText: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wabil-asḥāri hum yastaghfirūn
verses.translation: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,

verses.arabicText: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
verses.transliteration: Wafī amwālihim ḥaqqul-lilssāili wal-maḥrūm
verses.translation: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.

verses.arabicText: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wafī l-arḍi āyātul-lil'mūqinīn
verses.translation: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]

verses.arabicText: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wafī anfusikum afalā tub'ṣirūn
verses.translation: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?

verses.arabicText: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wafī s-samāi riz'qukum wamā tūʿadūn
verses.translation: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.

verses.arabicText: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fawarabbi s-samāi wal-arḍi innahu laḥaqqum-mith'la mā annakum tanṭiqūn
verses.translation: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.

verses.arabicText: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Hal atāka ḥadīthu ḍayfi ib'rāhīma l-muk'ramīn
verses.translation: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -

verses.arabicText: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Idh dakhalū ʿalayhi faqālū salāman qāla salāmun qawmum-munkarūn
verses.translation: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown.

verses.arabicText: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
verses.transliteration: Farāgha ilā ahlihi fajāa biʿij'lin samīn
verses.translation: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf

verses.arabicText: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Faqarrabahu ilayhim qāla alā takulūn
verses.translation: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"

verses.arabicText: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Fa-awjasa min'hum khīfatan qālū lā takhaf wabasharūhu bighulāmin ʿalīm
verses.translation: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.

verses.arabicText: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
verses.transliteration: Fa-aqbalati im'ra-atuhu fī ṣarratin faṣakkat wajhahā waqālat ʿajūzun ʿaqīm
verses.translation: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Qālū kadhāliki qāla rabbuki innahu huwa l-ḥakīmu l-ʿalīm
verses.translation: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."

verses.arabicText: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla famā khaṭbukum ayyuhā l-mur'salūn
verses.translation: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

verses.arabicText: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū innā ur'sil'nā ilā qawmim-muj'rimīn
verses.translation: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals

verses.arabicText: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
verses.transliteration: Linur'sila ʿalayhim ḥijāratam-min ṭīn
verses.translation: To send down upon them stones of clay,

verses.arabicText: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.transliteration: Musawwamatan ʿinda rabbika lil'mus'rifīn
verses.translation: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."

verses.arabicText: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-akhrajnā man kāna fīhā mina l-mu'minīn
verses.translation: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers.

verses.arabicText: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Famā wajadnā fīhā ghayra baytim-mina l-mus'limīn
verses.translation: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.

verses.arabicText: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.transliteration: Wataraknā fīhā āyatal-lilladhīna yakhāfūna l-ʿadhāba l-alīm
verses.translation: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

verses.arabicText: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.transliteration: Wafī mūsā idh arsalnāhu ilā fir'ʿawna bisul'ṭānim-mubīn
verses.translation: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.

verses.arabicText: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verses.transliteration: Fatawallā biruk'nihi waqāla sāḥirun aw majnūn
verses.translation: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman."

verses.arabicText: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
verses.transliteration: Fa-akhadhnāhu wajunūdahu fanabadhnāhum fī l-yami wahuwa mulīm
verses.translation: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.

verses.arabicText: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
verses.transliteration: Wafī ʿādin idh arsalnā ʿalayhimu r-rīḥa l-ʿaqīm
verses.translation: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.

verses.arabicText: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Mā tadharu min shayin atat ʿalayhi illā jaʿalathu kal-ramīm
verses.translation: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.

verses.arabicText: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.transliteration: Wafī thamūda idh qīla lahum tamattaʿū ḥattā ḥīn
verses.translation: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."

verses.arabicText: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Faʿataw ʿan amri rabbihim fa-akhadhathumu ṣ-ṣāʿiqatu wahum yanẓurūn
verses.translation: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.

verses.arabicText: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Famā is'taṭāʿū min qiyāmiw-wamā kānū muntaṣirīn
verses.translation: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.

verses.arabicText: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Waqawma nūḥim-min qablu innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīn
verses.translation: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.

verses.arabicText: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wal-samāa banaynāhā bi-aydiw-wa-innā lamūsiʿūn
verses.translation: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.

verses.arabicText: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَـٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَـٰهِدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wal-arḍa farashnāhā faniʿ'ma l-māhidūn
verses.translation: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.

verses.arabicText: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wamin kulli shayin khalaqnā zawjayni laʿallakum tadhakkarūn
verses.translation: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember.

verses.arabicText: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.transliteration: Fafirrū ilā l-lahi innī lakum min'hu nadhīrum-mubīn
verses.translation: So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

verses.arabicText: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.transliteration: Walā tajʿalū maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara innī lakum min'hu nadhīrum-mubīn
verses.translation: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

verses.arabicText: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verses.transliteration: Kadhālika mā atā alladhīna min qablihim mir-rasūlin illā qālū sāḥirun aw majnūn
verses.translation: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."

verses.arabicText: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
verses.transliteration: Atawāṣaw bihi bal hum qawmun ṭāghūn
verses.translation: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.

verses.arabicText: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ
verses.transliteration: Fatawalla ʿanhum famā anta bimalūm
verses.translation: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed.

verses.arabicText: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wadhakkir fa-inna dh-dhik'rā tanfaʿu l-mu'minīn
verses.translation: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.

verses.arabicText: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
verses.transliteration: Wamā khalaqtu l-jina wal-insa illā liyaʿbudūn
verses.translation: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

verses.arabicText: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
verses.transliteration: Mā urīdu min'hum mir-riz'qiw-wamā urīdu ay-yuṭ'ʿimūn
verses.translation: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
verses.transliteration: Inna l-laha huwa r-razāqu dhū l-quwati l-matīn
verses.translation: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.

verses.arabicText: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَـٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
verses.transliteration: Fa-inna lilladhīna ẓalamū dhanūbam-mith'la dhanūbi aṣḥābihim falā yastaʿjilūn
verses.translation: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.

verses.arabicText: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fawaylul-lilladhīna kafarū miy-yawmihimu alladhī yūʿadūn
verses.translation: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
